principle_violations.reason: Classes handle multiple responsibilities. 'Order' handles storing items and applying payment status. 'PaymentProcessor' subclasses handle payment processing and authentication.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibilities of order management and payment processing. Consider introducing a separate class for item management within 'Order' and delegate authentication to a distinct interface.

principle_violations.reason: Current implementation of payment processors does not allow for easy extension. To introduce new payment logic, changes in existing methods are required.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface for authentication and extend it for each payment type to implement their specific authentication logic separately.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
